text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty escalation fired for service=svc-hosted-inference (INC-2026-0423). Primary didn't ack within window; paging secondary now. PD link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-2026-0423 :rotating_light:
aj: I saw the bot — I'm on-call and trying to ack now
maria: saw a spike in 503s around 09:12 UTC in the hosted pool. Grafana spike + alerts. Not yet sure if it's infra or model OOMs
aj: acked (aj) :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: primary (sre-primary) missed ack -> escalated to secondary (song). Secondary not yet acked; automatic manager escalation queued
song: I didn't get the SMS page? checking PD delivery logs now
oncall-bot: PD webhook: notification delivery failed to +1-555-1234 (carrier delivery error). Retries attempted
devops: looking at k8s: model-worker pods are OOMKilled repeatedly. node pressure high, kubelet evicting caches. 4/12 nodes at >90% mem
maria: quick tail of logs from model-worker (truncated):
```
2026-04-23T09:12:02Z model-worker[pid=4218] OOM killed: killed process 4218 (transformer) total-vm:3200000kB
2026-04-23T09:12:03Z ERROR inference: batch failed with OOM on sequence_len=2048
```
aj: trying to ack secondary again... acked (song) :white_check_mark: — but PD still showing manager escalation in progress
maria: attempted a local scale up: `kubectl -n hosted scale deploy/model-worker --replicas=6` returned `Error from server (InsufficientResources): nodes "pool-hosted-*"  have insufficient memory`
song: confirmed I didn't receive SMS because carrier flagged rapid pages, PD retries dropped. i'll ping PD support after recovery
aj: fallback: initiate routing failover to dedicated cluster for serving-critical traffic. Doing a control-plane route update now
aj: command (control plane):
```
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood/api/v1/router/failover" \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
 -d '{"service":"svc-hosted-inference","target":"dedicated-west-1","reason":"hosted pool OOM cascade"}'
```
devops: failover API accepted, starting gradual shift (10% -> 100%) with 30s drain window
incident-bot: Manager pjohnson paged (call). Manager acknowledged (pjohnson) :telephone_receiver:
pjohnson: I'm in. good call on failover. assigning RCA leads. please get timeline and metric snapshots into the incident ticket
maria: failover progress: 30% traffic -> 100% in ~3 mins. Post-failover metrics: 503 rate dropped from 18% -> 0.6% and latency stable
aj: moving to an incident bridge. creating Zoom and doc. bridge: https://meet.redwood/incident-3169999999
sre-lead: owner assignment: @aj incident owner (coord + timeline), @maria logs + mitigation notes, @pjohnson lead for RCA & postmortem. please add follow-ups in the ticket
maria: adding quick timeline in the ticket and attaching pod logs + OOM traces. will run heap dump sample next
incident-bot: PD incident INC-2026-0423 status: resolved by user (aj). closing PD incident in 5m if no regressions
aj: thanks all — will open a follow-up ticket for autoscaler tuning + PD SMS fallback check. low-friction immediate action: cap sequence length client-side to reduce memory pressure until quantized worker rolls out
pjohnson: thanks. good triage and swift failover. tag this for oncall rotation review and PD escalation policy change
incident-bot: incident thread closed. summary: auto-escalation triggered due to missed primary ack; secondary transient delivery failure; root cause immediate = OOM cascade in hosted inference pool leading to 503s; mitigation = routing failover to dedicated cluster. Postmortem owners assigned. :memo:
